feeds.title: Minimalist Baker
feeds.description: Sharing simple, delicious plant-based and mostly gluten-free recipes. Minimalist Baker is about celebrating simple cooking with recipes that require 10 ingredients or less, 1 bowl, or 30 minute or less to prepare.

feeds.title: Vegan Richa » Gluten Free Vegan Recipes
feeds.description: This section features gluten free vegan recipes. Richa is an award winning recipe developer, blogger, and photographer behind Vegan Richa. She creates flavorful plant based recipes that are inspired by her Indian upbringing, including many gluten-free, soy-free, and oil-free options.

feeds.title: Rhian's Recipes
feeds.description: Easy, undetectably vegan plus gluten-free recipes, including healthy comfort food and naturally sweetened desserts using plant-based ingredients. Rhian started this blog with an aim to create recipes that fit a wide range of dietary requirements for those with food allergies and intolerances. She is a graduate of the University of Cambridge, also do a bit of work as a freelance journalist, and have written for publications such as UK national newspaper The Independent.

feeds.title: Feasting on Fruit
feeds.description: Feasting on Fruit sharing simple snacks and treats that are secretly healthy under their dessert disguises! Snacking made sweeter with fruit. Vegan, gluten-free, grain-free, and healthy recipes and inspiration for anyone with a sweet tooth!

feeds.title: The Vegan 8
feeds.description: The Vegan 8 blog is managed and owned by Brandi Doming. Her passion is truly in creating the most amazing desserts where her creativity flourishes. Many of her recipes focus on 8 ingredients or less, not counting salt, pepper, or water, but not all of them. She loves to create health-focused recipes, using whole foods to improve fitness and muscle-building, with the occasional comfort meal thrown in there. Discover more through her blog about recipes, cookbooks, plans, products, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Simple Vegan Blog
feeds.description: A food blog with simple, healthy, vegan recipes.Mostly gluten-free.

feeds.title: Dreena Burton
feeds.description: Let Dreena show you how to plant-power your diet! With tips and recipes for your family, including wheat, gluten, and soy-free options. Feel better, look better - eat plant-powered!

feeds.title: The Colorful Kitchen
feeds.description: I'm Ilene and I make, photograph (and eat!) all the recipes you see on the site. I'm a certified health coach, recipe developer and food photographer. I'm an NYC-based health coach here to share plant-based recipes that are colorful, not complicated.

feeds.title: Veggies Don't Bite
feeds.description: Get simple plant-based, gluten-free and whole food vegan recipes. Sophia creator of Veggies Don't Bite, is a mom to three boys. As a client-centered health coach, meal systems expert and plant-based recipe creator, she focuses on helping people feel empowered instead of overwhelmed when it comes to overall health and wellness.

feeds.title: Elavegan
feeds.description: Hello and Welcome to my blog Elavegan. My name is Michaela Vais. I'm a food stylist, recipe creator, photographer. I create healthy and delicious vegan dishes and share recipes with my readers. Most of my recipes are also refined as sugar-free, gluten-free and easy to make.

feeds.title: The Pretty Bee
feeds.description: Delicious allergy friendly recipes. Covers articles on gluten free, dairy free, and vegan recipes. Mom to two boys with food allergies and sensitivities, author Kelly is passionate about allergy friendly cooking and baking. She believes that you can enjoy amazing, easy recipes even when cooking for multiple food allergies.

feeds.title: Unconventional Bakers
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Audrey, the girl behind Unconventional Baker {formerly Gluten-Free Vegan Love}. I'm a baker, un-baker, blogger, photographer & food stylist, creating refined sugar-free, gluten-free, plant-fueled, often raw and always wholesome recipes I hope you enjoy this space and find something yummy to make!

feeds.title: Delightful Adventures
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Gwen and if you're looking for easy-to-make, delicious plant-based and gluten-free recipes you'll want to make over and over again, you've landed in the right place!

feeds.title: Eating by Elaine
feeds.description: Here I share my favorite healthy, vegan, allergy-friendly & gluten-free recipes.

feeds.title: Fragrant Vanilla Cake
feeds.description: I am a vegan girl who is passionate about good food! I especially like to create healthier desserts and veggie filled dishes. I also believe that food is art and is meant to be shared!

feeds.title: The Vgn Way
feeds.description: Hundred's of easy, affordable & delicious gluten-free vegan recipes. The Vgn Way offers great and healthy recipes for a plant-based diet.

feeds.title: Alternative Dish
feeds.description: Alternative Dish is a site dedicated to recipes that everyone can enjoy. All recipes are vegan, gluten free and give substitutes for the top 8 allergens whenever possible. Chef Maggie believes that everyone has the right to easy, flavorful food no matter what their dietary restrictions. Read on to eat with joy and ease!

feeds.title: My DairyFree Gluten Free Life
feeds.description: If you like Dairy-Free Gluten-Free or Vegan recipes, healthy giveaways, fun tips and more....follow this blog!

feeds.title: Gluten Free Blogger
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah Howells, aka The Gluten Free Blogger. I share gluten-free recipes and advice for living life with coeliac disease. From simple gluten-free bakes to meal ideas, coeliac humor, and more, The Gluten-Free Blogger has everything you need to start living and loving your gluten-free life.

feeds.title: Vegan Gluten Free Heaven
feeds.description: The blog like this page will provide information about gluten free and vegan living. You can find my ratings of Gluten Free/Vegan products,recipes,info about gluten and more.

feeds.title: The Vegan Monster
feeds.description: Vegan & glutenfree recipes for monster of all ages, shapes and sizes!

feeds.title: Light Orange Bean
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Joyce! I share many simple and healthy gluten-free, vegan friendly recipes here. As an organic chemist, I'm also looking for science behind cooking.

feeds.title: Oh She Glows
feeds.description: Gluten/Wheat Free Vegan Recipes by Angela Liddon.

feeds.title: The Bojon Gourmet
feeds.description: Many of my recipes are vegetarian, gluten-free, and some are even vegan.

feeds.title: Healthy Slow Cooking
feeds.description: Healthy Slow Cooking Blog posts on soy curl recipes, slow cooker recipes, air fryer recipes, instant pot recipes, and more. A vegan blog dedicated to easy, healthy food that your family will love. Also has some gluten-free, no added oil, and soy-free options and modifications for most recipes.

feeds.title: Naturally Sassy Recipes
feeds.description: Naturally Sassy Recipes of healthy vegan, Gluten Free & Raw Superfood recipes to fuel an active lifestyle.

feeds.title: Sarah Bakes Gluten Free
feeds.description: I'm Sarah, the baker and blogger here at Sarah Bakes Gluten Free. Creating gluten, dairy and egg free recipes, that are approachable and delicious.

feeds.title: Allergylicious
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nicole Dawson. On this website, I provide delicious, allergy-friendly recipes that everyone can enjoy. Always free-from dairy, eggs & nuts with many also Gluten Free. Welcome to my Kitchen! My goal is to give you the confidence to bake delicious vegan and allergy-friendly desserts to satisfy your sweet tooth.

feeds.title: Good Eatings
feeds.description: Welcome! My name is Malin and with my love for good, wholesome vegan food I started this blog. Here I share all my favourite recipes, my travel shenanigans and general thoughts on this and that. Stay tuned for delicious food and lots of good stuff

feeds.title: FriFran
feeds.description: I am totally dedicated to sharing Gluten-Free, Vegan ,Allergy-Friendly, Seasonal* recipes and lifestyle information and ideas.

feeds.title: Fresh is Real
feeds.description: Fresh is Real was designed to motivate people to eat more vegetables, fruits and plant-based ingredients with each meal and snack. It's a creative outlet to inspire kids, teens, and adults to have fun experimenting in the kitchen with fresh, simple, nutrient dense ingredients. This food blog is a safe place for sharing recipes and tips to lead a healthy plant-based and allergen-friendly lifestyle, especially for people dealing with multiple food allergies or sensitivities.

feeds.title: The Dopey Vegan
feeds.description: A blog providing easy inspiring vegan, diabetic friendly and gluten free recipes that can be achieved by even the dopiest of cooks.

feeds.title: BAKING BACKWARDS
feeds.description: Interested in allergy-friendly cooking? Going gluten free or vegan? Follow me for plant powered recipes and stories from my experimental kitchen!

feeds.title: Vegetarian Gastronomy
feeds.description: This website is dedicated to Vegetarian, Eggless Cooking... with many Vegan and Gluten-free options!

feeds.title: Pure Ella Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Pure Ella! I share delicious and nourishing plant-based wheat and/or gluten-free recipes that are always pure and natural! ps. I wrote a book about how you can cut sugar the healthy way so you don't feel deprived!

feeds.title: YumUniverse
feeds.description: YumUniverse shares infinite possibilities for a plant-based, gluten-free, vegan diet.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Cuppa Tea
feeds.description: Gluten free blog based in London, UK. Tried & tested award-winning recipes that are low FODMAP & dairy free too. Follow this blog for plenty of recipes & reviews that are applicable to those living gluten free, dairy free, sugar free, egg free & even living a vegan life style.

feeds.title: Gluten Free A-Z
feeds.description: A blog with healthy gluten free vegetarian and vegan recipes that are quick and easy which provides great support for those with celiac.
